items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's with Brian? Yeah, with Brian. [INTERVIEWEE] The young trumpet player? Yeah. That's right.

ctx.x: Jefferson Pass with Bryant. That's the longest parade, the hardest parade I played all my whole career. The hours were short but you walk, they walk the devil like this. It's not like these close dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear You gotta stop there, stop there. You walk without a stop. All true, Kevin. Never no more. Never more.
That's with Brian? Yeah, with Brian.

The young trumpet player? Yeah. That's right. So I said, never no more. I had a job sitting out. Why didn't he bring Joe Gordon out to a parade? I'd rather stay in New Orleans and play a car with the parade, and go out there and play. Because you do get some kind of a parade to rest. Something to eat, something to drink. Out there, you're gonna get nothing. That's a lot of things.
